stem: What should a shift handoff do with an unresolved crop abnormality?
choices: Omit it until a diagnosis is final
Replace uncertainty with the most likely cause
State what remains unresolved, what was escalated and what follow-up is required
rationale: State what remains unresolved, what was escalated and what follow-up is required. This response preserves the Course 002 evidence, identity, role-boundary or documentation principle being assessed.
